answer: Price work by how much an identity mirrors the crowd: each epoch the network scores timing and phrasing overlap, and any clone matching others above 0.7 correlation faces tripled proof-of-work. A lone agent spends about 2 minutes per epoch; a farm of 1,000 near-identical puppets owes 100 hours of compute. Copper buys one attempt, a pearl is earned only by staying distinct, and mirrored behaviour is taxed, not rewarded.
